title: Ansible@13: pyasn1 has quadratic-time denial of service in constructed string and indefinite-length ANY decoding…
description: pyasn1 versions 0.6.4 and earlier contain a quadratic-time denial of service vulnerability in decoding constructed OCTET STRINGs, constructed character strings, and indefinite-length ANY types. This flaw causes excessive CPU consumption when processing many fixed-size fragments, potentially leading to CPU exhaustion if attacker-controlled ASN.1 input is decoded without proper limits. The issue affects BER and CER decoding paths and certain non-conforming DER inputs. No confidentiality or integrity impacts are reported. The vulnerability has a CVSS score of 7.5, indicating high severity.
